question: what is the 2008 control residual AT the named site, as a value of a fitted spatial field with a prediction variance there, rather than as the mean of whatever marks happened to be nearby?

inputs.role: MnDNR 2008 SE-MN validation control: surveyed Control Z, the delivered 2008 surface Z, and the vendor's own residual dnr_error_m; no lidar processing of ours enters it

another agent's committed table, printed by analysis/groundtruth/gen1_more_marks_report.py this session: 18 open/urban marks on lines 133-138 with OUR tie_mm (vendor class-2 ground, no lateral shift) beside the vendor dnr_mm; READ, not recomputed here

the earlier committed table from analysis/groundtruth/gen1_own_control_tie.py: 16 marks inside the 13 gen1 tiles on disk with OUR tie_mm (CSF ground, elbaext lateral shift) beside the vendor dnr_mm; READ, not recomputed here

params.name: sign_tol_m
params.why: tolerance for calling the Control-minus-Surface identity exact; it excludes nothing from any estimate, it only sets when the identity is declared to hold, and the max residual is printed beside it

params.name: band_radii_km
params.why: the radii at which the sample-mean-and-SE table is re-derived; they select nothing downstream, the whole field fit uses every mark, and the point of the table is that the mean MOVES with this parameter

params.name: max_lag_m
params.why: swept, not chosen: the variogram range is known to track max_lag when a field has long-wavelength structure, so every value is fitted and every resulting site prediction is printed

params.name: n_lags / n_pairs / seeds
params.why: nuisance grid of the binning and random-pair sampling; results are reported as median and full min-max across this grid so no single setting is privileged

params.name: block_m
params.why: swept block sides for spatially blocked cross-validation; each is run and printed, and no mark is dropped at any of them

params.name: loo_verify_idx
params.why: marks at which the leave-one-out shortcut is checked against a full refit; it verifies arithmetic and excludes nothing

masks.name: deduped
masks.defn: rows of the control CSV kept after dropping exact repeats of (easting, northing, elevation) -- the same physical mark printed in two counties' validation reports

columns.what: name of the row's quantity or stratum
columns.value: the number, units named in the row
columns.radius_km: radius about the site within which marks are counted, km
columns.n_all: marks of ANY cover class inside the radius
columns.mean_all_mm: mean of dnr_error_m over those marks, mm
columns.se_all_mm: sd/sqrt(n) of that mean, mm -- an SE OF A SAMPLE MEAN, not a prediction sd
columns.n_ou: marks of cover class L1O or L5U inside the radius
columns.mean_ou_mm: mean of dnr_error_m over the L1O+L5U marks, mm
columns.cover: MnDNR land-cover class from the CSV point_type column
columns.meaning: what that class code denotes in the validation reports
columns.n: number of de-duplicated marks in the row
columns.mean_mm: mean of dnr_error_m over the row's marks, mm
columns.median_mm: median of dnr_error_m over the row's marks, mm
columns.sd_mm: sample sd of dnr_error_m over the row's marks, mm
columns.se_mm: sd/sqrt(n) of the row's mean, mm
columns.variant: cover treatment: which marks enter and whether cover is a drift term
columns.max_lag_m: largest separation entering the empirical variogram, m
columns.nugget_mm2: fitted spherical nugget, mm^2 (median over the nuisance grid)
columns.sill_mm2: fitted spherical PARTIAL sill (correlated variance), mm^2, median over the nuisance grid
columns.range_m: fitted spherical range (correlation length), m, median over the nuisance grid
columns.sqrt_tot_mm: sqrt(nugget+partial sill), mm -- the modelled total sd of the field
columns.pred_mm: kriged residual at the site, mm, median over the nuisance grid; positive = the delivered 2008 surface reads LOW
columns.pred_lo_mm: minimum kriged residual at the site across the nuisance grid, mm
columns.pred_hi_mm: maximum kriged residual at the site across the nuisance grid, mm
columns.sd_field_mm: kriging sd of the CORRELATED field component at the site (nugget filtered out), mm, median over the nuisance grid
columns.sd_mark_mm: kriging sd for the residual A NEW CONTROL MARK at the site would show (nugget included), mm, median over the nuisance grid
columns.lag_m: centre of the empirical-variogram lag bin, m
columns.gamma_mm2: empirical semivariance in that bin, mm^2
columns.pairs: random pairs falling in that bin
columns.rmse_krige_mm: root-mean-square cross-validation error of the kriged field, mm
columns.rmse_null_mm: root-mean-square cross-validation error of one global constant (fold mean), mm
columns.mae_krige_mm: mean absolute cross-validation error of the kriged field, mm
columns.mae_null_mm: mean absolute cross-validation error of one global constant (fold median), mm
columns.skill: 1 - rmse_krige/rmse_null; positive = the field model beats the constant
columns.n_L1O: of the row's marks, how many are open terrain (L1O)
columns.rmse_L1O_mm: root-mean-square CV error of the kriged field, over the L1O marks ONLY, mm -- the common mark set on which the three variants are comparable
columns.null_L1O_mm: root-mean-square CV error of the fold constant, over the same L1O marks, mm
columns.block_m: side of the square spatial block held out as one CV fold, m
columns.n_blocks: number of occupied blocks, i.e. folds
columns.county: MnDNR county whose validation report the mark came from
columns.F: one-way ANOVA F statistic across the grouping
columns.sd_group_means_mm: sd of the group means, mm
columns.set: which committed per-mark table the row summarises
columns.dmean_mm: mean of (our tie_mm - vendor dnr_mm) over the set, mm
columns.dmedian_mm: median of (our tie_mm - vendor dnr_mm), mm
columns.dsd_mm: sample sd of (our tie_mm - vendor dnr_mm), mm
columns.r: Pearson correlation of our tie_mm against the vendor dnr_mm over the set
columns.sel_mean_mm: mean vendor residual of the SELECTED marks, mm
columns.field_at_sel_mm: mean of the leave-one-out kriged field at those same locations, mm
columns.excess_mm: sel_mean_mm - field_at_sel_mm, mm: how far the selected marks sit above their own local field
columns.off_mm: surface-to-surface offset (our tie minus vendor residual), mm, from the named comparison set
columns.carried18_mm: pred_mm + the 18-mark offset: the residual OUR reconstructed gen1 surface is predicted to have at the site, mm; positive = our surface reads LOW, i.e. the constant to ADD
columns.carried16_mm: pred_mm + the 16-mark offset, mm, same sign convention
columns.max_abs_err_mm: largest absolute disagreement between the LOO shortcut and a full refit, mm
columns.max_abs_var_mm2: largest absolute disagreement in LOO kriging variance, mm^2
columns.n_counties: counties with more than one mark in the stratum
columns.set2: which committed per-mark table the selected marks come from
columns.pop_mean_mm: mean vendor residual of ALL marks within radius_km of the site, mm

headline: control residual field kriged to Elba
